notes: Zilla 3.0 workflow registry. Every rule is deterministic. No rule carries predictive status; all are 'unvalidated' until the separate research process says otherwise. rules_v1.json is kept unchanged as the historical v1 policy.
changes_from_v1: DN5 is now the digit sum of month, day and two-digit year (10/21/2026 -> 1+0+2+1+2+6 = 12); v1 added the two-digit year whole.
Added DAY-GEM and PLANET-GEM: five-cipher gematria of the weekday and its ruling planet.
Removed ZODIAC-SYNC: zodiac season is a descriptive tag.
Supplied numbers without a phrase and cipher are 'source pending' and do not count toward Prime Cluster, Triple Prime Sync or the control test.
Added the control test (alternative milestones), decode status, freeze/amend and outcome grading.
workflow: 01 Input lock: player, date, opponent, stat milestone; inputs hashed (input_sha256)
02 Number generation: birthday spans, calendar codes, gematria, primes
04 Ritual overlay: jersey, moon, zodiac, weekday/planet, symbolic keywords
05 Signal validation: exactness, verified source, independence, duplicate check
06 Control test: alternative milestones in a fixed window
07 Decode output: grid, Excel summary row, JSON audit with every comparison
08 Freeze: reports are never overwritten; changed inputs create an amendment
09 Grade: outcomes go to a separate ledger and never edit the decode
10 Learn: research engine (not part of this tool)

conventions.gematria: Letters only, case-insensitive. Ciphers: EO (a=1..z=26), FR (EO digit-reduced), RO (a=26..z=1), RR (RO digit-reduced), CH (Chaldean).
conventions.prime_index: 1-based: 2 is the 1st prime, 23 is the 9th prime.
conventions.DN2: month + day + each digit of the year (10+21+2+0+2+6 = 41)
conventions.DN3: every digit of month, day and year (1+0+2+1+2+0+2+6 = 14)
conventions.DN5: every digit of month, day and two-digit year (1+0+2+1+2+6 = 12)
conventions.DAYS_LEFT: days remaining in the year after the event date
conventions.birthday: Exact spans from birth date to event date. Feb 29 birthdays are observed on Feb 28 in non-leap years. Spans are distinct anchors and never substituted for one another.
conventions.triple_prime_sync: At least 3 verified prime-related hits drawn from at least 3 distinct source families AND at least 3 distinct source numbers.
conventions.source_verification: Gematria from a supplied phrase is verified (phrase and cipher are recorded). A bare supplied number is 'source pending' until it is replaced by its phrase.
conventions.milestone_type: cumulative = a running count reaching a new value (career HR #23); threshold = a single-game line (20+ points). Recorded with every decode.
conventions.moon_phase: True phase instants from Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms (2nd ed., ch. 49), dT = 69 s; accurate to about a minute. A date takes a principal phase name (New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon, Last Quarter) if that instant falls within the calendar day in the event timezone (UTC if none given); otherwise the intermediate name after the latest principal phase. Moon age is measured at event_time if given, else local noon. Descriptive tag only.
conventions.zodiac: Tropical sun signs on a fixed date table: Aries 3/21, Taurus 4/20, Gemini 5/21, Cancer 6/21, Leo 7/23, Virgo 8/23, Libra 9/23, Scorpio 10/23, Sagittarius 11/22, Capricorn 12/22, Aquarius 1/20, Pisces 2/19. Descriptive tag only.
conventions.control_test: The same sources are decoded against every alternative milestone within +/- window of M (values >= 1, M excluded). Reports how many alternatives have at least as many verified structural hits. Descriptive rarity only, not a probability of the milestone.

REVPRIME-M.name: Reverse prime milestone
REVPRIME-M.qualification: reverse(M) is prime and reverse(M) != M

PIGR-A.name: Prime milestone to gematria index
PIGR-A.qualification: M is prime and prime_index(M) == G

PIGR-B.name: Gematria prime to milestone index
PIGR-B.qualification: G is prime and prime_index(G) == M

DAY-GEM.name: Weekday gematria sync
DAY-GEM.qualification: a cipher value of the weekday name == M

PLANET-GEM.name: Ruling planet gematria sync
PLANET-GEM.qualification: a cipher value of the weekday's ruling planet == M

SYM.name: Symbolic code
SYM.qualification: value is in a locked symbolic set
